dimensions.name: Accuracy
dimensions.description: Technical correctness: 9-10 fully correct, 7-8 few errors, 5-6 partly correct, 0-4 many errors or incorrect.

dimensions.name: Technical Depth
dimensions.description: Depth of understanding: 9-10 explains essence and analyzes deeply, 7-8 is clear, 5-6 is surface-level, 0-4 shows no understanding.

dimensions.name: Reasoning
dimensions.description: Reasoning quality: 9-10 is logical with examples, 7-8 relatively logical, 5-6 fragmented, 0-4 has no reasoning.

dimensions.name: Application
dimensions.description: Practical application: 9-10 relates to a real project, 7-8 gives an example, 5-6 gives a simple example, 0-4 cannot apply it.

dimensions.name: Communication
dimensions.description: Communication quality: 9-10 clear and professional, 7-8 understandable, 5-6 hesitant, 0-4 hard to understand.

levels.description: Almost no correct or relevant evidence.
Very weak understanding with major errors.
Partial understanding below the expected requirement.
Generally correct with missing depth or evidence.
Good answer with clear reasoning and relevant application.
Very good answer with strong technical evidence.
Exceptional mastery with complete evidence and trade-off analysis.
